title: PrepBot-3000
abstract: Prepare for a chess opponent in the thirty seconds before the game starts. PrepBot-3000 pulls a Lichess opponent's recent games, ranks their openings and habits by information gain, and asks a language model for short preparation advice, all served as a live web app.
highlight: It is deployed and usable by anyone with a Lichess account.

demos.alt: PrepBot-3000 public table of analysed games
